item.title: South Wellfield residents to benefit from £1.2m water mains renewal investment
item.description: Northumbrian Water is set to begin a £1.2m investment in South Wellfield, North Tyneside to upgrade aging water mains and strengthen the resilience of the local water network. The project will see 8.4km of water mains renewed, significantly improving reliability and reducing the likelihood of future leaks or bursts for customers. This will ensure homes […]
